description.ja: 地球連合軍から、地球内の治安維持にも運用される警備型量産機「テックプロト」が登場！
description.en: From the Earth Alliance Forces, the mass-produced security aircraft "Tech Proto", which is also used to maintain public order on Earth, has arrived!

description.ja: ■大型シールドが付属。新技術によりシールドの模様を１パーツで再現。
description.en: • Comes with a large seal. Using new technology, the Seal pattern is reproduced in one part.

description.ja: ■局地戦をサポートするスコープ型のバイザーが付属。
description.en: • Comes with a scope-type visor to support local battles.

description.ja: ■リアスカートは背中への取り付けも可能。
description.en: • The rear skirt can also be attached to the back.

description.ja: ■装甲パーツを取り外すことで軽装状態を再現可能。
description.en: • Lightly armored condition can be reproduced by removing armored parts.

description.ja: ■機体各箇所に可動ギミックを搭載。
description.en: • Equipped with movable gimmicks in each part of the aircraft.

accessories.ja: グレネードランチャー×1
